goal: Convert Needs Review projects into closed, split, dispatched to TOD, waiting on evidence, waiting on Dave, or archived successor states.
acceptance_criteria: Needs Review drops from 15 to under 5.
Every reviewed project gets a successor action and evidence requirement.
No project remains Needs Review without an age and reason.
Each reviewed project is classified as closed, split, dispatched to TOD, waiting on evidence, waiting on Dave, or archived.
Public TOD route repair remains separate and does not mix into this objective.
first_driving_task: Review the highest-priority Needs Review project and convert it into a successor state with an evidence requirement.
policy: Needs Review is not a resting state. MIM/TOD must decide and record the next execution, evidence, or closure path.
measurement: Review Resolution Rate measures whether Needs Review projects become real successor states instead of notes.
